paragraphs: A generic template gets you started, but reworking every clause that doesn't fit the actual deal often takes longer than it saved you — and things get missed under time pressure.

AI tools match a template to your deal's specifics — parties, jurisdiction, deal type — and pre-fill known details, so you're editing a document that's already 80% right instead of starting from zero.
overview.callout: A matched template is a starting point, not a finished contract — every clause still needs your review before it goes to the other side.
whatItCanDo: Match a contract template to your deal's specifics.
Pre-fill known details like party names and jurisdiction.
Flag clauses in the template that commonly need negotiation for this deal type.

howToUse.copy: Describe the deal, and it matches a template and pre-fills what it can — you review and negotiate from a document that's already close to right.
howToUse.videoCaption: See a deal description turned into a pre-filled draft contract in minutes.

download.copy: Works in your browser — nothing to install.
download.videoCaption: Your first matched template takes about five minutes.

detail.toolsIntro: Three tools: template matching, clause negotiation flags, and a library of firm-approved templates.

tools.name: Templatematch
pointers: Matches a contract template to your deal's specifics.
Pre-fills known details like party names and jurisdiction.

tools.name: Negflag
pointers: Flags clauses that commonly need negotiation for a deal type.
Draws on patterns from past deals, not guesswork.

tools.name: Approvedlib
pointers: Keeps your firm's approved templates in one searchable library.
Version-controlled, so everyone drafts from the current one.

quickFacts.label: Where your data goes
quickFacts.value: Your own account; nothing shared externally
